sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use Mật khẩu Wi-Fi không hoạt động. for "The Wi-Fi password is not working.". Mật khẩu Wi-Fi không hoạt động.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Mật khẩu Wi-Fi không hoạt động. for "The Wi-Fi password is not working.". Keep the phone screen or error message visible.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Practice Mật khẩu Wi-Fi + không hoạt động first; the full line keeps the request from sounding chopped up.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Keep close by: What is the Wi-Fi password? and Do you sell SIM cards?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best in a SIM shop, hotel desk, or cafe counter, before the explanation gets long. Keep the phone screen, error message, charger, or map app close for the follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Phone and Wi-Fi answers can be technical. Let the screen stay visible so the other person can point, type, or check the setting.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Keep close by: My phone battery is dead, Do you have a charger, and Can I charge my phone here.
